related.title: PostgreSQL：CHECK 約束與金額定點表示
related.titleEn: PostgreSQL: CHECK constraints and fixed-point amounts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：從重複顧客地址的訂單表找出更新異常，再以鍵驗證分解。 驗收紀錄必須包含通過/失敗、重現方式和剩餘限制；只對已檢查的模型範圍作結論。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Find update anomalies in orders repeating customer addresses, then validate decomposition using keys. Acceptance includes pass/fail,reproduction instructions and remaining limits; conclusions stay within the checked model.
related.difference: 設計價格、數量與折扣的資料契約，用整數分避免二進位小數累積歧義。
related.differenceEn: Define price, quantity and discount contracts using integer cents to avoid binary-fraction ambiguity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 顧客 ID 決定地址，訂單 ID 決定顧客；把不同實體的相依混在一起會產生修改不一致。 教學基準：7*80 = 560 duplicated address bytes；第二檢核：2*80 = 160 normalized address bytes。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
NOT NULL、CHECK 與 UNIQUE 分別處理缺值、值域與重複；一種約束不能替代其他兩種。 教學基準：199*3 = 597 gross cents；第二檢核：floor(597*0.9+0.5) = 537 net cents。逐項保留單位、分母、排序或時間界線。 先手算或逐事件枚舉，再使用SQL、試算表或本機腳本重算，保存中間狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Customer ID determines address and order ID determines customer; mixing dependencies creates update inconsistencies. Teaching baseline: 7*80 = 560 duplicated address bytes; second check: 2*80 = 160 normalized address bytes. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.

NOT NULL,CHECK and UNIQUE address absence, domains and duplication; none substitutes for the other two. Teaching baseline: 199*3 = 597 gross cents; second check: floor(597*0.9+0.5) = 537 net cents. Retain units,denominators,ordering and time boundaries. Enumerate by hand before using SQL,a spreadsheet or a local script; preserve intermediate states.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
